verdict.rationale: Synctera documents an ACH guide and references issuing ACH debits against verified external accounts. A general Webhook API exists for pushing event updates. Together these establish basic API-driven ACH origination with event notifications. Missing for 10: explicit ACH credit origination, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as first-class objects, ACH-specific webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
